items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer asks about Little Esther, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal anecdote or relationship description regarding her, instead discussing Larry Darnell and Big Maybelle.

ctx.x: They didn’t want to handle – do anything for any of the artists that he was handling. That’s why I say, poor Maybelle. I know she had a rough time with . . .
Let’s talk about a couple of those artists in that period that you hooked up with, like Big Maybelle and Little Esther.
Larry Darnell. Remember that one? Larry Darnell was one of his hits.
